cds.title: Columbus State University Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF; newest edition posted)

stats.notes: Common Data Set 2024-2025 (fall 2024 entering class); the 2025-2026 edition was not posted on Columbus State's Common Data Set page. Residency split (in-state / out-of-state / international): applicants 3,400 / 236 / 15, admits 3,370 / 232 / 15, enrolled 1,084 / 85 / 6; the extracted PDF layout was garbled, but each row sums exactly to the printed totals (3,651 / 3,617 / 1,175). The GPA breakdown is not shown because the column layout could not be read reliably; the average GPA of 3.18 is clearly printed. Only 13% submitted SAT and 12% ACT scores, so the score ranges describe a small self-selected group. The admission-factor checkboxes were unreadable and are not shown. No early decision or early action; no waitlist.

cost.notes: Costs from the Common Data Set as printed for the full 2025-2026 year (30 credit hours): in-state tuition $5,610 ($187/credit), out-of-state $20,250 ($675/credit); the Common Data Set also lists a separate 'Non-resident' tuition of $21,270 without saying who pays it, so international tuition is not shown. Required fees $1,410; on-campus food and housing $12,070; books $1,760
